evidence.observation: 4.8 ppm at start of growth, after purge brought O2 down to about 4-7 ppm
Rose steadily to 21.9 ppm (8.4, 13.9, 16.2, 21.9) during growth
Mass flow controller reads 99.9 sccm against a 100 sccm setpoint, so no sign of a flow fault
749.8 °C with heater power steady at about 45%; temperature control is normal
Pressure gauge not installed, so the tube atmosphere cannot be checked by pressure

args.missing_evidence: A tube pressure reading, or a leak check / exhaust-line check, is needed to tell a seal leak (air getting in) from an exhaust blockage. Watching how O2 responds to a change in Ar flow would also help.
